fileSave.current: boolean; true only when identity.revision and captured text match this draft; only show current draft saved/denied/conflict label when true
fileSave.identity: immutable operationId/epoch/workspaceId/path/kind/revision/floor/request reference and optional expected backupId
fileSave.backupId: optional; verified confirmed saved reference only; identity.backupId is a plan, never a verified backup

flags.denied: draft.fileSave?.status === 'denied'; code explains no confirmed save; explicit reload required
flags.conflict: draft.fileSave?.status === 'conflict'; preserve text; explicit reload required
flags.unknown: draft.fileSave?.status === 'unknown'; may have changed original; preserve draft; no retry/reload/content polling
flags.editing: allowed during save; captured identity remains original
flags.discard: allowed during save; ends draft binding only; operation still settles
flags.backup: display draft.fileSave.backupId only for saved and current workspace/path/epoch; never identity.backupId

public_ui_checkpoint.eligibility: connected selected registered workspace; current epoch/path loaded version or explicit missing_file observation; shared configurationFileWriteFits; dirty available text or missing-create; no global/resource hold, pending operations, actual file read/save, logical configuration read, unknown save or capacity exhaustion; blank instructions do not need valid draft format, Host confirms actual clear
public_ui_checkpoint.save_return: true means the original operation has a validated confirmed receipt; use fileSave.status/current to label the current draft, because discarded or newer drafts can coexist with historical success

early_evidence: Actual UI checkpoint was published during implementation before final checks; public action and draft fields remain the same.
work_class: routine within accepted configuration-save plan revision2/designv1
implementation: Normal existing transport v2 envelope, captured expectedRevision floor, immutable captured epoch/workspaceId/root path/kind/revision and exact frozen request reference. No renderer approval flag or new DTO/helper shape.
Loaded baseline version or exact missing_file observation in current epoch/root only; failed reads, local comparison baseline, root changes and epoch changes cannot authorize a rewrite.
Shared lossless configurationFileWriteFits; blank instructions clear is eligible independent of empty-invalid format. Actual Host confirmation remains authoritative.

Sole store owns configuration draft save statuses and actual file-read/save counters. Controller wraps existing bridge invocation only to account for actual promise settlement; timeout/cancellation does not release actual busy lane.

Matching closed confirmed receipt plus direct response requestId/version/expected operation-derived backup correlation updates baseline to captured bytes. New edits keep text/revision and fileSave.current=false.

Discard/recreate, workspace away/back, root away/back, removed workspace, local comparison baseline and epoch replacement retire UI binding permanently; historical receipt only updates original operation.

Unknown strips executable operation payload into original lookup-only identity and preserves resource hold/draft. No automatic save resend, configuration reload or configuration content polling. Existing bounded operation lookup scheduling is retained.

Denied CANCELLED and pre-effect FILE_CHANGED are distinct denied/conflict states only on valid closed rejected/none receipt. Filesystem errors without no-effect receipt stay unknown. Fresh explicit observation required after denial/conflict.

Closed save receipt/result/evidence validation rejects raw fields, wrong key/workspace/kind/version/backup, missing evidence/result, floor clocks, regression from dispatched to rejected, and changes to terminal receipt. Host-held keys stay held even with confirmed historical lookup.
Existing ordinary operation composite keys, clock/bootstrap protections, and file read tests remain intact. All new tests append to the existing file; no existing assertion was weakened.
limitations: Tests use the actual controller/store/transport and synthetic bridge responses; this worker did not execute the full Host filesystem save chain. Main owns separate kernel/IPC/service/journal integration evidence.
Native/Electron/provider/full build/production Main were not invoked.
Independent CODE and rendered UI review plus broad final integration checks remain Main-owned. This report is implementation evidence, not self-approval.
